result: No material blocker found in the reviewed changes.
checks: The load_catalog API comment and regression accurately say envelope syntax is parsed before ordered semantic manifest validation; the malformed-later-JSON test expects envelope parsing failure without entry-0 semantic context.
format is an owned String, and a JSON-escaped equivalent of the supported format is accepted in the regression.
The packer trims only the four JSON whitespace characters, rejects non-JSON NBSP whitespace, and rejects NaN, Infinity, and -Infinity through parse_constant; added tests align with those branches.
remaining_non_blocking_note: Python json.loads still accepts duplicate object keys by default while the packer retains raw source bytes. Thus success from the packer alone does not guarantee every arbitrary source file will pass serde_json in the Rust loader; this does not affect the shipped 75 manifests and is outside the two requested fixes.
verification_scope: No builds, tests, benchmarks, or timings were run by this reviewer.
